people.name: Jabez
people.line: More honorable than his brothers; God granted his prayer.

translations.web: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
translations.bsb: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
translations.kjv: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
translations.asv: And Jabez was more honorable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
